subject: VMWARE_ESXI

sutProfile.guestDriver: virtio-net plus raw PCI config and heartbeat probe
sutProfile.workload: Correctable-only O4/g101 Root sequence: first/multiple, independent Endpoint/Root W1C, B0/B1 OR, and re-arm; four sequences by three repeats

expected: All 12 cases are evaluated against the preregistered, hash-bound public oracle without changing the oracle bytes or downgrading injected cases to pre-injection cases.
Correctable Endpoint and Root state transitions for first/multiple reception, independent W1C, bit OR, and re-arm are compared exactly while Uncorrectable injection is unavailable.
Every case restores the original E/M/R gate, leaves no active runner-created VM user, and preserves a running outer QEMU.
Bounded host-log absence remains a negative observation and is never promoted to proof that no ESXi interrupt or service path ran.
observed: The immutable 12-case O4/g101 plan completed 12 of 12 cases; every case entered Correctable-only injection, matched the frozen oracle, completed cleanup, required no containment, and left the outer QEMU running.
First/multiple repeated B0 reception kept Endpoint CES at 0x00000001 and CED set, while Root Correctable Status changed from 0x00000001 to 0x00000003 and Source remained 0x0101.

Endpoint-only W1C cleared Endpoint CES/CED without clearing Root Correctable Status or Source; after re-priming, Root-only W1C cleared Root Correctable Status without clearing Endpoint CES/CED. Source is not interpreted when Root COR_RCV is clear.
B0 followed by B1 produced Endpoint CES 0x00000041 with CED set and Root Correctable Status 0x00000003 with Source 0x0101.
After Endpoint CES, CED, and Root Correctable Status were cleared, B0 re-armed the same Endpoint CES 0x00000001, CED, Root Status 0x00000001, and Source 0x0101 state.

Each sequence produced one stable observation digest across three repeats; the offline verifier reported FULL_PLAN, verified=true, requireCompleteSatisfied=true, 12 exact cases, 822 case-manifest entries, and 840 root-manifest entries.
All observed Uncorrectable status surfaces remained zero, all gates were restored, and the maximum observed safety-poll gap was 0.04229792801197618 seconds under the 0.05-second limit.
No matching AER line was observed in the strict per-source host log windows. This does not establish absence of interrupt delivery or ESXi service execution.
limitations: The verdict remains PARTIAL because only the exact nested ESXi 8.0.3 build-24280767 O4/g101 synthetic-endpoint slice is established.
O0, other E/M/R gates, Root Command notification effects, guest-write isolation, lifecycle clear and reuse, and physical-device health or recovery remain unverified.
No interrupt delivery or ESXi service attribution is inferred from bounded log absence.
No VMware private code, internal control flow, filter, synthesis, or service implementation is reconstructed.
Synthetic Correctable injection does not qualify a physical link or physical device.
This VMware reference result grants no Qman implementation, qualification, acceptance-case, risk, gate, or release closure.
